Wattage

Features:

Introducing unique possibilities with the new Phanteks Revolt X Series, the first dual-system power supplies. They’re able to support a secondary system and power it individually thanks to Phanteks’ patented technology. The Revolt X series power supplies provide 80 PLUS Platinum efficiency, Hybrid mode for quiet operation, and fully modular cables. Powered by Seasonic, the Revolt X power supplies are bringing high reliability and power to the enthusiast market aimed at high performance systems, either single or dual system PCs.
